title: Play to People's Fantasies
coreMove: Offer a seductive story that lets people move toward hope without colliding too fast with fact
sourcePressure: Chapter 32 centers on the pull of pleasing stories over harsh reality. The law values fantasy-aware persuasion because many people move more readily toward hope, glamour, and seductive narrative than toward difficult truth alone. Its limit is that fantasy becomes unstable when it drifts too far from reality, invites disillusionment, or turns into promises that cannot survive contact with facts. Frozen sidecar provides no traceable named anecdote for this chapter; do not fabricate named source anchors.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: telling people fantasies with no reality behind them
